scripts.example:dev: pnpm build && pnpm -C examples/basic run dev
scripts.doctor: pnpm run nabecms:doctor && pnpm run example:doctor
scripts.test: pnpm run core:test && pnpm run admin:test && pnpm run cli:test && pnpm run starter:test && pnpm run tooling:test
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm doctor
scripts.lint: pnpm run core:lint && pnpm run admin:lint:ci
scripts.format: pnpm run core:format && pnpm run admin:format
scripts.format:check: pnpm -C packages/nabecms-core exec prettier --check src/ && pnpm -C packages/nabecms-admin exec prettier --check src/
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run core:typecheck && pnpm run admin:typecheck

DB.description: D1 database used for content, auth, and CMS settings.

R2.description: Private R2 bucket used for uploaded media and generated variants.

ASSETS.description: Workers Assets binding used to serve the Admin application at `/admin`.

AUTH_LOGIN_RATE_LIMITER.description: Required Workers Rate Limiting binding for login attempts: 10 requests per 60 seconds.

AUTH_SENSITIVE_RATE_LIMITER.description: Required Workers Rate Limiting binding for initialize and invite operations: 5 requests per 60 seconds.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Optional. Public base URL paired with `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` for local Better Auth sessions.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Optional. Secret paired with `BETTER_AUTH_URL` for local Better Auth sessions. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

JWT_SECRET.description: Generate a random secret with `openssl rand -hex 32` for admin JWT signing.

BOOTSTRAP_SECRET.description: One-time bootstrap secret required to create the first admin account.
